call_points.text: Management expects organic growth in FY27 to be better than FY26 with an acceleration in the second half.
FY27 pipeline is 17% higher than a year ago, balanced across Top-20 and outside-Top-20 clients.
Industry is strong and adopting AI; biotech is coming back.
New solutions Tectonic and Medical Writing are getting traction.
Acquisitions Cult, Trilogy, Biopharm, Warn and Cake Communications add local credibility and relationships.
The company describes a zero-debt balance sheet.
Management expects profitability and EBITDA margins to improve in FY27 as investments are absorbed.
Active customer base expanded from 73 to 91 during the year with strong traction in GenAI-led solutions.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: This is the first disclosure as the Company received Assessment Order under Section 143(3) read with Section 144C(3) read with Section 144B of the Income Tax Act, 1961 for the Assessment Year 2023-24 (corresponding to the Financial Year 2022-23)
tax_litigation.status: The Company firmly believes that its current positions are well supported on facts, principles and under the law. To obtain certainty and mitigate the risk of economic double taxation, the Company has filed an application for resolution through the Mutual Agreement Procedure (MAP) under the Double Taxation Avoidance Agreement (DTAA) between India & United States of America. In parallel, the Company will also pursue appropriate remedies under the domestic appellate framework to safeguard its interests until the MAP process is concluded. The Company is confident of a fair and timely resolution with no material liability on the Company. At this stage, the Company does not expect any material adverse impact on its financial position or operations. The Company will keep the stock exchanges informed of any further material developments in accordance with applicable regulations

The lawsuit relates to alleged violations of the U.S. Telephone Consumer Protection Act, 1991 (TCPA), concerning certain fax communications made in February 2020. Following class certification in July 2025 and dismissal of the defendants’ petition seeking permission to appeal the class certification, the parties participated in court-referred mediation and subsequently negotiated the settlement terms and definitive settlement documentation. The parties have now substantially concluded negotiations on the definitive settlement agreement. Following final clarifications from external counsel on August 18, 2026, the Company confirmed that it had no further comments on the settlement agreement and authorised it to proceed for execution. The settlement remains subject to execution by the relevant parties and approval by the U.S. District Court. It does not constitute an admission of liability by the Company or the defendants. Further to the Company’s disclosure dated August 19, 2026, regarding the proposed settlement of the class action litigation, the United States District Court for the District of New Jersey, by order dated August 27, 2026, has granted preliminary approval to the proposed class action settlement. The Court has approved the form and manner of notice to the settlement class, appointed Analytics as the Settlement Administrator, and directed issuance of notice to settlement class members on or before September 10, 2026. The Court has also prescribed timelines for submission of claims, requests for exclusion, and objections, all of which are required to be submitted on or before December 9, 2026. The final approval hearing has been scheduled for January 12, 2027. The settlement remains subject to final approval by the C

operating_notes.text: FY26 acquisition payments of ₹724 Cr (net of cash acquired) drove goodwill to ₹1,134 Cr.
FY26 exceptional item was a ₹20 Cr litigation provision booked in Q4FY26.
Indegene recognized as a Leader in ISG Provider Lens for Life Sciences Digital Services in Commercial Operations for the third consecutive year.
Income Tax Department raised a ₹43.68 Cr demand (including interest) for AY2023-24 on ₹123.41 Cr transfer-pricing adjustments; Indegene has filed for MAP under the India-US DTAA.
FY27 pipeline is 17% higher than at the same point last year, balanced across Top-20 and outside-Top-20 clients.
Top 10 clients hold 51% of revenue; 9 Tier-1 clients contribute 24.2% and 7 Tier-2 clients 26.5%.
FY26 consolidated goodwill ₹1,134.3 Cr and other intangibles ₹483.3 Cr, together 52% of net worth.
FY26 consolidated related-party flows tagged at ₹12.30 Cr, all key management personnel other transactions.
Q1FY27 segment results: Enterprise Medical Solutions ₹71.6 Cr, Enterprise Commercial Solutions ₹119.7 Cr, Others -₹11.5 Cr.
Q1FY27 other income of ₹29.0 Cr was 19.0% of PBT of ₹152.7 Cr.
TCPA class action provision of ₹41.7 Cr (USD 4.72 million maximum settlement) unchanged as at 30 June 2026; term sheet signed 25 May 2026.
Care Edge Monitoring Agency Report for Q1FY27 shows ₹742.74 Cr utilized out of ₹760 Cr IPO proceeds.
Indegene, Inc. finalised a definitive TCPA class action settlement with a maximum fund of USD 4.72 million (USD 250 per eligible approved claim), with no upfront funding or escrow required.

US subsidiary Indegene, Inc. received preliminary court approval on 27 August 2026 for a TCPA class action settlement with a maximum fund of approximately USD 4.72 million and USD 250 per eligible approved claim; no payment has been made to

Merger of Indegene Healthcare Germany GmbH into Trilogy Writing & Consulting GmbH registered in Frankfurt; surviving entity renamed Indegene Healthcare Germany GmbH, projected FY27 revenue Euro 20,100,000.
Indegene announced the incorporation of a new step-down subsidiary, Indegene Portugal, Unipessoal LDA, held 100% by Indegene Ireland Limited.

timeline.summary: Indegene reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹3,511 Cr and PAT of ₹401 Cr; and recommended a ₹2.25 final dividend.
Indegene reported Q4FY26 revenue of ₹1,003 Cr up 32.8% YoY and recommended a ₹2.25 final dividend.

Indegene Limited shared the Q4 and Annual FY26 Earnings Call audio recording on April 30, 2026, via **https://bm.indegene.com/Audio-Recording-Q4FY26-Earnings-Call-30-Apr-2026.mp3**, signed by **Srishti Ramesh Kaushik**.
Indegene was named a Leader in the ISG Provider Lens for Life Sciences Digital Services for the third consecutive year.
Indegene received a ₹43.7 Cr income-tax demand for AY2023-24 on ₹123.4 Cr transfer-pricing adjustments and has filed for MAP resolution under the India-US DTAA.
Indegene reported Q4 FY26 revenue of ₹1,003 Cr and FY26 annual revenue of ₹3,511 Cr.
Indegene's May 2026 analyst presentation flagged a FY27 pipeline 17% higher than a year earlier and set a $500M+ near-term revenue ambition against ~$400M today.

Indegene's board fixed 13 August 2026 for its 28th AGM and 31 July 2026 as the record date for the ₹2.25 per share FY26 final dividend, and reconstituted its audit, risk management and investment committees.

Indegene's FY26 annual report carried an unmodified Deloitte opinion, ₹3,510.5 Cr consolidated revenue (+23.6%) and ₹401.1 Cr profit (-1.4%), with goodwill up to ₹1,134.3 Cr after the year's acquisitions.
Q1FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,063.1 Cr (+39.7% YoY), net profit ₹116.2 Cr (-0.2% YoY).
Indegene published its Monitoring Agency Report for Q1FY27 showing ₹742.74 Cr utilized out of ₹760 Cr IPO proceeds.
Indegene announced Q1FY27 consolidated revenue of ₹1,063.1 Cr, up 39.7% YoY, with active clients crossing 105.
Indegene Limited hosted an earnings call for Q1 FY27 on July 31, 2026, with audio recording available via the provided link.
Indegene reported Q1FY27 consolidated revenue of ₹1,063.1 Cr, up 39.7% YoY, with active clients reaching 105.
Indegene Limited’s 28th AGM held on August 13, 2026, passed all resolutions with required majorities via virtual/other audio-visual means.
Indegene Limited published the transcript of its 28th Annual General Meeting held on August 13, 2026.
Indegene announced that its US subsidiary finalized a definitive settlement agreement for a TCPA class action with a maximum fund of USD 4.72 million.
Indegene announced that the US District Court preliminarily approved a definitive TCPA class action settlement with a maximum fund of USD 4.72 million.
Indegene completed the merger of its German indirect subsidiaries, with Trilogy Writing & Consulting surviving and renaming to Indegene Healthcare Germany GmbH.
Indegene incorporated a new step-down subsidiary, Indegene Portugal, Unipessoal LDA, through its Irish subsidiary.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,122.3 Cr (+39.6% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹112.3 Cr.
Indegene Q2 revenue rises 39.5% YoY to ₹1,122.3 Cr; EBITDA margin at 16.7%
Indegene reported Q2 FY27 revenue of ₹1,122.3 Cr and PAT of ₹112.3 Cr, driven by strong growth across top accounts.
Indegene Limited held its earnings call for the 2nd quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026 on 30 October 2026, providing an audio recording link.
